videos.script: Spark forgets. Run two actions on the same DataFrame, and it reads the files twice. {{twice}} Most of the time that is right, because memory kept for one result is memory taken from the work. This lesson is about the other times. {{when}} Cache the purchases, and the second question costs one second instead of five. Cache the links of a graph, and ten iterations of PageRank take two and a half minutes instead of six. {{loop}} Then what a cache costs: memory, the first use, and an executor that dies and takes its partitions with it. {{cost}} And a loop whose plan grows by fifty lines an iteration, until a checkpoint cuts it back to four. {{checkpoint}}
